senses.gloss:
(डु अष) औख्^1 r. 1st cl. (लभते)
To obtain, to get or gain.
(इ) लभि r. 1st cl. (लम्भते)
1 To sound.
2 To injure.
3 To revile.
4 To gain.
With उप prefixed.
1 To apprehend, to understand.
2 To delay.
With उप and आङ्,
To revile, to abuse.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

r. 10th cl. (लाभयति)
To throw, to send or direct.

m. (-भः)
1 Gain, profit.
2 Gain in general, acquirement, acquisition.
E.
लभ to get or gain, aff. घञ्.

m. (-सः)
1 Wealth.
2 A solicitor, one who asks or solicits.
3 A horse's foot rope.
E.
लभ to get, Uṇādi aff. असच्.

mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं)
1 Attainable, procurable.
2 Fit, right, proper.
E.
लभ to get, aff. यत्.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Gaining, making profit.
E.
लाभ, and कृत् who makes.

mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Covetous, grasping, desirous of gain or profit.
E.
लाभ, and लिप्सु desirous.

m. (-भः)
Profit and loss.
E.
लाभ, and अलाभ not gain.
